item.title: Economic impact of war in Iran starts to set in
item.description: NEW YORK (PIX11) — The war in Iran is sending economic shockwaves around the world and the tri-state area. The military strikes and counterattacks by Iran are leading to a lot of uncertainty, especially around future fuel supply. There are also questions around financial markets— putting 401(k)s, pensions, and other retirement funds at risk.

item.title: War widens as Trump says Iran strikes could last several weeks
item.description: With no sign of the conflict abating anytime soon, the president said operations are likely to last four to five weeks but that he was prepared “to go far longer than that.”

item.title: Legendary NYC restaurant closing after 25 years
item.description: CHELSEA, Manhattan (PIX11) – Elmo Restaurant, a community fixture in Chelsea, is closing after 25 years, its owners announced Monday morning. Elmo Restaurant's founder, Bob Pontarelli, said the building on Seventh Avenue was sold, ending the restaurant’s long-standing lease. The restaurant’s last dinner will be on March 13, Pontarelli said in a post to Instagram. [...]
